every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 hides the text card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D anchor rack is not covered by the overlay as it is in frame 4 of Site 2, though both still clip the card over the rack in frame 5.

explains_the_project.reason: While both use the same 3D press, rack, and host-gate machinery across frames 1-9, Site 2 keeps the explanatory card visible in frames 4 and 7 so the visitor always has context alongside the 3D scene.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the exact same grounded 3D models, materials, lighting, and gridded floor across all 9 frames.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 has identical typography and card styling, but gives the 3D scene breathing room in frames 4 and 7 instead of letting the left card overlap the anchor rack in frame 4 like Site 2.

overall.reason: Both sites are nearly identical builds of the same 3D factory visualization, but Site 1 handles scroll transitions cleaner in frames 4 and 7 by clearing the text card while the camera moves across the left side of the viewport.
